equivariance_check — DRIVE pegtactile op

• Data kinds: any × any × signal × scalar × signal → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.equivariance_check(render, op, angles, n: 'int', centre) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import pegtactile; pegtactile.equivariance_check(render, op, angles, n: 'int', centre) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("equivariance_check"))

Usage

Building block for the equivariance gate: draws the shape rotated by angle θ (render(θ) → image) and checks whether the answer of a perception op (op(画像) → (row, col, orientation)) changes as the group action dictates. Expected: the position rotates by θ about centre = (row, col) and the orientation advances by θ (mod 2π/n; for n = 0 the orientation is not compared). Returns pos_err_px (maximum), ang_err_deg (maximum, shortest distance mod 2π/n, nan if not compared) and rows (per angle). Raises ValueError: render or op is not callable, not even 1 angle or non-finite angles, n < 0, centre does not have 2 components.
